scenes.text: A double-bar graph places paired values side by side for comparison. Always read both axes and the key.
One bar shows 30 and another 18. What is the difference? The answer is 12. Compare the two bars: |30 minus 18| equals 12.
Two bars in a recycling club show Class A equals 29 and Class B equals 10. Which class has the taller bar? Pause the video and think.
Two bars in a recycling club show Class A equals 29 and Class B equals 10. Which class has the taller bar? The answer is Class A. The larger bar is 29, belonging to Class A.
